messages:
Ryan (sales): quick heads-up, NovaCore POC goes live in 30m. They chose Private (VPC) + SAML SSO. Seeing auth failures and intermittent 429s in our test runs. need a short war-room to avoid delaying demo :grimacing:
Mia (CS): copying notes from onboarding: customer will run on-prem gateway -> our private control plane. security Q done but they asked for IP allowlist and session logging. timeline: demo tomorrow 10am PT.
Sam (eng): @Ryan can you paste the failing request/response? also which model & concurrency are they hitting?
Ryan (sales): minimal repro from their infra team (sanitized):
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: private.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Body: {"input":"hello"}
Response: 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","retry_after":1.2}
```
They said spikes at ~120 req/s, bursty bursts for short windows.
Oliver (infra): are they hitting Dedicated throughput or Private with autoscaling? If private we need to confirm their gateway is routing correctly and we aren't double-counting concurrency.
Ryan (sales): private with their own GPU pool (on-prem) but using our private control plane for routing. they set concurrency=8 per worker.
Sam (eng): okay two likely causes: 1) our fronting router applies global rate limits for new tenants until capacity warms; 2) their gateway retries without jitter causing amplification. can we get a pcap or logs?
Mia (CS): I asked for logs and the SAML assertion failure transcript. seat-of-pants timeline: security wants IP allowlist and KMS key mapping before we move to prod.
Sofia (security): also we need to confirm audit-log retention settings for the customer (they requested 1 year) and that HSM integration is documented. I'll start a checklist.
Sam (eng): for immediate triage I'll provision a temporary higher-rate policy for the org id so we can smoke test while we investigate. @Oliver can you open a temporary policy override (10x) and route to a canary pool? annotate in infra logs.
Oliver (infra): creating override now. deploying canary pool nodename=novacore-canary-01. assigning tag org:novacore. will post CIDR to allowlist once done.
deploy-bot: override policy novacore-override created by Oliver at 2024-08-20T15:10:12Z :white_check_mark:
Sam (eng): thanks. @Ryan ask them to stop aggressive client retries for 10m while we validate. and capture one raw request/response with headers (we need SAML header and x-org-id).
Ryan (sales): asked them to pause retries. they sent back SAML failure logs: "InvalidIssuer" and a short stack from their IdP. forwarding to Sofia.
Sofia (security): likely mismatch between SP entity ID and their IdP config, or clock skew. ask them to check cert thumbprint + time sync. also confirm we do not store raw SAML assertions in logs — we only log assertion ID and status.
Mia (CS): pricing note: customer asked if we can do a short-term commit discount if we hit demo SLA. legal asked for an MSA amendment for private deployments.
Ryan (sales): putting that on my list. can we get a decision window today? demo is a hard milestone.
Sam (eng): quick fixes tracked:
- temp rate override (Oliver) : in progress
- confirm client retry backoff (Ryan) : asked
- SAML InvalidIssuer (Sofia) : collecting IdP metadata
- increase TTL on KV cache to reduce load on model for repeated prompts (Sam) : optional
- enable prefix caching for their common prompts (Sam) : low effort

Oliver (infra): canary up, CIDR 203.0.113.0/28 added to allowlist, routing verified. logs show initial success then 429s stopped. tagging the traffic.
Ryan (sales): customer confirms demos now go through for 1:1 requests, still seeing failure on burst load test.
Sam (eng): run a quick load test from our staging harness simulating their retry pattern. if 429 persists under canary, we should enable burst capacity throttle change and bump per-org queue depth. I'll run tests now.
(5m later)
Sam (eng): load test reproduced. root cause: their gateway opens N parallel connections and retries immediately on 429 -> causes feedback loop. mitigation: enforce per-connection retry jitter and server-side adaptive throttling.
Sam (eng): pushed a soft throttle that smooths bursts (policy novacore-smooth-2024-08-20). observing fewer 429s, p50 latency unchanged.
Ryan (sales): :tada: customer did a smoke demo with product team. they flagged SSQ item re: data residency and audit log export.
Sofia (security): on SSQ: confirm audit log export path (S3-compatible endpoint in their VPC), retention config, and KMS key rotation policy. I'll draft answers and paste into their security questionnaire.
Mia (CS): also note: they requested a written runbook for cutover and rollback for tomorrow's demo. I'll assemble a short playbook and assign roles.
Ryan (sales): big thanks everyone. follow-ups: Sam -> finalize soft throttle & move to per-org policy; Oliver -> keep canary for 24h; Sofia -> SSQ answers + SAML guidance; Mia -> runbook + customer comms; Ryan -> pricing ask and MSA amendment loop.
Oliver (infra): keeping canary. I'll annotate metrics and set an alert if 429% > 1% over 5m.
Sam (eng): I'll prepare a tiny change set for the optimizer (prefix caching + kv ttl) if we still see spikes tomorrow.
Ryan (sales): closing the loop for now. will reopen if anything blocks demo. :thumbsup:
Mia (CS): noted. good job team.
Sofia (security): adding SSQ answers to the thread shortly.
